sources.title: Main Fire Tree Avenue graph and detour inspection
sources.notes: Captured old car candidate left Fire Tree at [120.476857,16.004916] for unnamed road, Acacia Street and Caimito Street, rejoining at [120.456339,16.024251]. Main Fire Tree ways form a connected secondary corridor with mapped maxspeed40, and no access/motorcar/motorcycle restriction or oneway on that stretch. The old detour takes 313.4 s for 3482.2 m across those three roads; a fastest/weighted car choice is consistent with this, not proof of a tricycle prohibition. Roundabout approaches 1337197869/1337197870 are one-way and remain respected. Two exact OSM node shaping points (550881916,7829187213) plus main-road bearing matching at the unchanged supplied Firetree observation eliminate the off-main candidate; independent responses support each direction. No road segments were manually joined or restrictions ignored. One 529 m sparse segment is the actual adjacent nodes 7828477491/9168738433 on way35866813; narrowly allowed, not densified. Current OSM and engine graph vintage can differ; tags are not service legality or field verification.
